body.value: Specifications "White" 1896 Model C.
Frame. High diamond pattern; 1-inch cold
drawn seamless steel tubing, height 24 or
26. inches, ¾-inch tubing in rear forks,
3-inch tubing in rear upright forks.
Frame Parts. All steel connections, strongly
reinforced where necessary.
Forks. Steel fork sides, gracefully curved and
mechanically reinforced. Double fork
crown.
Steering Head. 9 inches long, 1¼ inches in
diameter.
Handle Bar. Cold drawn weldless steel, tube
⅛-inch in diameter. Stationary in high,
low or ram's horn position, as desired
Handles. Cork or corkaline. White composi-
tion tips.
Wheels. 28 inches, front and rear.
Wheel Base. 43 inches.
Rims. Kundtz single piece wood, reinforced
at joint.
Tires. Choice of Vim, Morgan & Wright, New
York, North American or Goodrich tires.
Spokes. Swaged piano wire, 28 in front, 36 in
rear. Swaged. 080 to .o60.
Pedals. Grothe,
rat trap or rubber. Dust
proof centers and bearings.
Cranks. Special steel, round and tapered, with
throw 6½ inches long.
Chain. ¼-inch solid link with hardened steel
centers.
Saddles. Black, very handsome in appearance
and specially manufactured to order.
Saddle Post. Style "T," "L" or direct seat
post.
Tread. 5 inches.
Sprocket Wheels. Front detachable, steel drop
forgings. Front sprocket overhangs crank
bracket, bringing chain directly over the
ball race.
Gear. 68 regular, 64 or 72 furnished if desired.
Bearings. Made of best selected high-grade
steel, carefully tempered and dust proof.
We show a far superior construction of
the crank bearing to any before used.
Patent applied for.
Hubs. Large tubular hubs, from seamless steel
tubing.
Furnishings. Tool bag, wrench, oiler, pump
and repair kit. Saddle and tool bag in
black leather.
Finish. Handle bar, hubs, sprocket wheels,
cranks, pedals, seat post, spokes, screws,
nuts and washers, nickel plated over cop-
per, remainder black enamel.
Weight, 23 pounds, with Fittings.
